title: 2026 CX AI Playbook: Strategic Outlook and Investment Properties
summary: 2026 CX AI Playbook: Strategic Outlook and Investment Properties jhernandez Fri, 06/05/2026 - 11:54 Image Donna Fluss President, DMG Consulting LLC Image Tim Richter Senior Director of Product Marketing, Five9 Customer expectations are shifting fast and the technology required to meet them is evolving even faster. In this strategic webinar with Donna Fluss and Tim Richter, we’ll dive into the exclusive findings from the newly released 2026 CX AI Playbook. The mandate is clear: AI is fundamentally redefining the customer experience, and the future belongs to brands that are ready to modernize. In this session, we’ll explore how forward-thinking organizations are investing in AI, automation, analytics, and orchestration to enable customers to experience The New CX through highly connected, personalized journeys. You’ll learn how to: Navigate the top CX AI investment priorities that will define enterprise strategies in 2026 Modernize your contact center operations to deliver measurable business outcomes Overcome the key hurdles impacting AI adoption to ensure sustained ROI Harness the emerging trends driving The New CX transformation across industries Expect exclusive benchmark data, expert guidance, and a strategic roadmap you can start building today.
